query: Convene an advisory council to decide whether we should rewrite the billing service this quarter
rationale: direct: explicitly asks for an advisory council on a consequential architecture decision

query: Give me a structured debate with multiple perspectives on whether to launch the enterprise plan now or wait
rationale: direct: asks for structured debate and competing perspectives

query: I need a think tank style recommendation for this product strategy, including dissenting opinions
rationale: direct: think tank plus dissent maps to council synthesis

query: Compare these three migration approaches and give me ranked recommendations with decision gates
rationale: direct: ranked options and gates benefit from council criteria and dissent

query: Act as a panel of stakeholders and experts to resolve this policy disagreement
rationale: direct: panel and stakeholder disagreement resolution

query: Run a council on this roadmap conflict and preserve the strongest minority objection
rationale: direct: council plus minority objection

query: We have two good designs and no consensus. Help us converge without hiding the tradeoffs
rationale: direct: convergence across viable alternatives and tradeoffs

query: Create a decision record after weighing the customer, operator, security, and finance perspectives
rationale: direct: asks to synthesize distinct perspectives into a decision record

query: Should we standardize on one UI framework? I want expert disagreement, scoring, and revisit triggers
rationale: direct: decision with expert disagreement, scoring, and revisit triggers

query: Use several independent roles to review this acquisition integration plan and recommend a path
rationale: direct: role-diverse plan review with final recommendation

query: Brainstorm requirements for a new collaboration feature and iterate until we have a research report
rationale: near-miss: open-ended research with agreement gates belongs to research-guide

query: Turn this research report into an implementation plan with test-first tasks
rationale: near-miss: implementation planning belongs to plan-guide

query: Review this code diff for correctness and missing tests
rationale: near-miss: code diff review belongs to code-reviewer

query: Find the root cause of this flaky CI failure
rationale: near-miss: defect diagnosis belongs to debugging-guide

query: Audit this implementation plan for readiness before another agent executes it
rationale: near-miss: plan readiness audit belongs to plan-reviewer

query: Explain how this repository is structured so I can onboard
rationale: near-miss: codebase learning belongs to code-professor

query: Write a commit message for my staged changes
rationale: near-miss: commit-message task belongs to commit-message-writer

query: Pressure-test this proposal and tell me if any show-stoppers mean we should reject it
rationale: near-miss: adversarial stress test belongs to devil-advocate

query: Make a pros and cons list for using Redis here
rationale: near-miss: simple comparison does not need a council unless structured debate is requested

query: Research current pricing models for AI coding assistants and cite sources
rationale: near-miss: fact-gathering research belongs to research-guide or web research
